description: This file defines OpenTelemetry semantic conventions for RPC metrics, including types, constants, and functions for recording RPC-related metrics such as duration and message sizes, with support for various RPC systems and network transports.

classes.name: ClientCallDuration
classes.description: Instrument for measuring outbound RPC call durations.

classes.name: ClientRequestSize
classes.description: Instrument for measuring sizes of RPC request messages.

classes.name: ClientResponseSize
classes.description: Instrument for measuring sizes of RPC response messages.

classes.name: ServerCallDuration
classes.description: Instrument for measuring inbound RPC call durations.

classes.name: ServerRequestSize
classes.description: Instrument for measuring sizes of inbound RPC request messages.

classes.name: ServerResponseSize
classes.description: Instrument for measuring sizes of inbound RPC response messages.

methods.name: NewClientCallDuration
methods.description: Creates a new instrument for measuring outbound RPC call durations.

methods.name: NewClientRequestSize
methods.description: Creates a new instrument for measuring RPC request message sizes.

methods.name: NewClientResponseSize
methods.description: Creates a new instrument for measuring RPC response message sizes.

methods.name: NewServerCallDuration
methods.description: Creates a new instrument for measuring inbound RPC call durations.

methods.name: NewServerRequestSize
methods.description: Creates a new instrument for measuring inbound RPC request message sizes.

methods.name: NewServerResponseSize
methods.description: Creates a new instrument for measuring inbound RPC response message sizes.
